system.description: Two or more of your thralls lock limbs and fuse into a wall of meat along their spaces; they are destroyed when it ends. Test Sanity (DR16). On a success, Sustained: the wall is 10' long and 10' high for each thrall in it, blocks movement and gives heavy cover. Each 10' section has 5 HP.

outcomes.failure: The wall is slack: it gives light cover and does not block movement.
outcomes.ruin: The thralls collapse in a heap and are destroyed.

outcomeEffects.note: two or more thralls fuse into a wall 10' long and 10' high per thrall: it blocks movement and gives heavy cover; each 10' has 5 HP
